title: MZ RPG Maker MZ, trying to understand how to put new idle animations.

posts.author: MapacheRosa
posts.body:
Hi, I'm just starting out and honestly, I'm completely lost. Can anyone help me?
To begin with, I'm using the Expedition 33 QTE Plugin - RPG Maker MV by GBRO, which I bought. It also uses the Dragonbones Plugin, but I've spent days and hours trying to understand not only the program itself but also how to implement these animations, and it's a complete mess. I'm trying to use PNGs for attacks and combos.
Example:
The main RPG Maker MZ system uses small sprites. I'm not sure what the best approach is, but I'd like to be able to assign sprites to each specific hero or enemy attack, either as separate images or grouped together.
The problem is, I don't know how to implement this, or if it even works, since the plugins I'm using have a specific format that I don't quite understand.
I currently have these plugins; do I need any others? Thanks! I hope someone can help me.
These plugins change the original battle system and allow me to parry the enemy when they attack, and other different things. I don't really know how to program well, so that's why I bought them.
Thanks for reeding, I hope someone can help me!
